discarded_claims.claim: The trace's schema-level impairment is not a policy-level impairment and should not push this case to a reviewer. No limb of POL-NS-08 bites: the largest sampling interval is 26 s against the 120 s gap threshold and the gaps list is empty; the trace holds 52 fixes against the 6-fix minimum and 31 rider fixes; the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 2 with contiguous msg_ids; and the 4.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the RYDE_X tier fee, so there is no fare defect. POL-GEN-02's confidence cap is therefore not dragged below the 0.70 floor, and in any event the deciding fact is carried on two independent artifacts - the GPS trace at 0.8 and the trip record at 1.0 - so the cap is the maximum, 1.0. No limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged and the case is decidable on the papers.
discarded_claims.reason: Non-disclosure under POL-GEN-02(1)/citation check limb (c). The claim cites EV-GPS-00206, whose weight_multiplier is 0.8 with issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, but it only refers in general terms to a 'schema-level impairment' — it never names the issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE or the 0.8 weight. The disclosure rule requires both the fact of impairment and the issue codes that fired in the same claim, so the claim is discarded.

discarded_claims.claim: POL-NS-07's 80 per cent driver compensation is not available on this record. That clause operates only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', which cannot be said where limb (b) and limb (d) both fail. The driver's only route to money, if any, is the platform-funded half-fee goodwill in POL-NS-03(ii), which cannot be charged back to the rider. The rider should not be paying a $3.20 driver compensation out of a $4.00 fee for a pickup the driver never reached, and the fare ledger should show nothing taken from her.
discarded_claims.reason: Non-disclosure under POL-GEN-02(1)/citation check limb (c). The claim rests on EV-GPS-00206 for the failure of POL-NS-01 limb (b), and that artifact carries weight_multiplier 0.8 with issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, but the claim says nothing at all about the impairment — neither the weight nor the issue code. Complete silence about an impaired artifact discards the claim.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — rider and driver. The $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the platform pays the driver a $2.00 goodwill payment. The two amounts are independent and are never set off against each other.

Why the fee cannot stand. A no-show fee requires all four conditions in POL-NS-01 to hold, and two of them fail on undisputed telemetry. The arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup is 120 m; the driver's own device never came closer than 284.95 m to the pin (mean 1,704.82 m, maximum 5,480.89 m), so limb (b) fails. He also never held position inside that radius at all — the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s against the 300 s minimum, a 300 s shortfall — so limb (c) fails. And the trip was closed with reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three codes limb (d) recognises; POL-NS-01 says in terms that this code is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Any one of these failures makes the charge unchargeable.

What this trip is. Both accounts agree, and the record confirms: the app's pin was the VivoCity Level 1 Lobby L ride-hailing pickup, while the map put the driver at the HarbourFront kerb across the road. That is POL-NS-03 — the wrong face of the same venue. The driver was stationary about 285 m from the pin for roughly 6.6 minutes: outside the 120 m arrival radius, inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and past the 300 s minimum. On those facts POL-NS-03 refunds the fee to the rider in full. POL-NS-05 does not convert this into a false-arrival event: at the arrival marker the driver was stationary within 300 m of the pin, and that clause expressly routes such a driver to POL-NS-03. No false-arrival referral is therefore recorded.

Who absorbs the cost. Neither party named a sub-location — the chat log holds only two system notifications — and this pickup has 4 registered pickup points. Under POL-NS-03(ii) the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, so the driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of half the $4.00 fee, $2.00. It is charged to the platform and is never recovered from the rider.

Evidence weight. The distance and dwell findings rest on EV-GPS-00206, which is impaired at weight 0.8 with issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median sample interval 18 s against a nominal 10 s cadence). The impairment concerns sampling cadence, not position: the largest gap is 26 s, well inside POL-NS-08(b)'s 120 s threshold, and 52 fixes span the window, so the 284.95 m closest approach and the stationary period hold and the finding survives the discount. No limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 bites, no POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged (the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 187 completed trips, a rate of 0.005), and the confidence of 0.8 is above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided on the papers and is not escalated.

Two of the rider advocate's claims were discarded before weighing because they cited the impaired GPS trace without naming its issue codes as the disclosure rule requires; they are recorded in the audit.
